answer: The hoop maker fits the iron-bound hoop round the cheese mould, tapping the bands home with a mallet till the mould holds its shape under the press. Herb rennet cream potter cream writ is the fitting here: a writ rennet cream potters sign after potting shed audits. The walnut opens the fitting, the atlas closes the band, the orchard proves the mould. A cheat must do 383 false tappings and 383 false fittings.
